env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# SPEC 2.5: a comptime instance is analysed in the scope of the package that
# declares the generic. The generic may name unexported identifiers of that
# package, and an importer may instantiate it.
cd m
logos build ./...
logos run .
stdout '^a \[x:int y:int\]$'
stdout '^b \[x:int y:int\]$'
stdout '^main \[x:int y:int\]$'
stdout '^local \[title:string id:int raw:other\]$'
stdout '^width 2 3$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

# One instance exists per generic and type argument list in the linked
# program: three packages and one plain generic instantiate Describe with
# shared.Point, and two sites instantiate it with the local type. The plain
# generic lives in package main, because an exported forwarding function
# fails with [comptime::exported_forwarder] (SPEC 2.5).
logos build -gcflags=all=-l -o $WORK/identity.exe .
go tool nm $WORK/identity.exe
stdout -count=2 ' T example\.com/identity/lib\.Describe\.logosct\.[0-9a-f]{64}$'

# SPEC 2.5: logos eject prints each instance in the package that instantiates
# it, and lib.Describe names the unexported type lib.entry, so eject refuses
# the module.
! logos eject -o out
stderr '^(\./)?lib/lib\.lgo:[0-9]+:[0-9]+: \[comptime::unexported_in_exported\] a comptime instance ejected into package example\.com/identity/a names unexported entry of package example\.com/identity/lib$'
! stderr 'internal compiler error'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/identity

go 1.27

-- m/shared/shared.lgo --
package shared

type Point struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

-- m/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import (
	"comptime"
	"strings"
)

type entry struct {
	name string
	kind string
}

func kindOf[F any]() string {
	const switch F {
	case int:
		return "int"
	case string:
		return "string"
	}
	return "other"
}

func lower(s string) string {
	return strings.ToLower(s)
}

func render(entries []entry) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(entries))
	for _, e := range entries {
		out = append(out, e.name+":"+e.kind)
	}
	return out
}

func Describe[T any]() []string {
	var entries []entry
	const for _, f := range comptime.Fields[T]() {
		entries = append(entries, entry{name: lower(f.Name), kind: kindOf[f.Type]()})
	}
	return render(entries)
}

-- m/a/a.lgo --
package a

import (
	"example.com/identity/lib"
	"example.com/identity/shared"
)

func Point() []string {
	return lib.Describe[shared.Point]()
}

-- m/b/b.lgo --
package b

import (
	"example.com/identity/lib"
	"example.com/identity/shared"
)

func Point() []string {
	return lib.Describe[shared.Point]()
}

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/identity/a"
	"example.com/identity/b"
	"example.com/identity/lib"
	"example.com/identity/shared"
)

type local struct {
	Title string
	ID    int
	Raw   []byte
}

func width[T any]() int {
	return len(lib.Describe[T]())
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("a", a.Point())
	fmt.Println("b", b.Point())
	fmt.Println("main", lib.Describe[shared.Point]())
	fmt.Println("local", lib.Describe[local]())
	fmt.Println("width", width[shared.Point](), width[local]())
}
